tokens.name: background-primary
tokens.usage: App and page background (the base canvas on web and mobile).

tokens.name: background-secondary
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: sidebars, grouped-list backgrounds, table headers, input fills, app chrome. Darker than the canvas in dark mode.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, form panels: anything that sits on a background.

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Floating layers: dialogs, bottom sheets, menus, popovers. Pair with shadow-lg; in dark mode the lighter fill carries the elevation.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, ghost buttons and menu items (web); the highlight state on mobile.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed/active fill for rows and ghost buttons; selected segmented-control track.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Toasts, tooltips and snackbars: the inverted surface.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, card outlines, table rules. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of interactive controls: inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons. 3.2:1+ on background-primary and surface-card in both themes.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on every background and surface (10:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy that should still read strongly: descriptions, table cells, form values (6.5:1+ on every ground).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, placeholders, hints, inactive tab labels. On background-primary and surface-card (4.7:1+ in both themes). Light theme on background-secondary is 4.4:1: keep it to 14px+ there, or use text-secondary.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and values only (exempt from contrast minimums). Never for content people must read.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse (17:1 light, 13:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on accent-primary, accent-hover, accent-pressed and danger-solid fills (4.8:1+).

tokens.name: accent-primary
tokens.usage: The brand violet, kept exact in both themes. Fills primary buttons, selected checkboxes and switches, and the round create button, always with a text-on-accent label or check mark on it (5.7:1 in both themes). Never used as text in dark mode: links, active tabs and nav labels use accent-text (#a78bfa, 6.1:1 on background-primary), so every text pair passes. As a fill in dark it is 2.9:1 against background-primary, just under the 3:1 guide for a shape's edge; the label or check inside carries the meaning. Bare violet marks with no label (a progress bar, a selected outline) use accent-text in dark.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for accent-primary controls.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for accent-primary controls.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted background for selected rows, accent badges, avatar fills, the active nav pill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, active tab labels and accent-coloured text on background-primary, surface-card and accent-subtle (5.2:1+ light, 5.5:1+ dark).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour (alias of accent-text); 5.5:1+ on every ground in both themes. Used by shadow-focus.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on the surfaces and success-subtle. Always pair with an icon or word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of success alerts and badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on the surfaces and warning-subtle. Always pair with an icon or word.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of warning alerts and badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, invalid-field borders and messages, destructive text buttons; on the surfaces and danger-subtle. Always pair with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of error alerts and badges.

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Fill of destructive buttons, with text-on-accent (4.8:1).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons on the surfaces and info-subtle.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of info alerts and badges.

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Roboto Mono", monospace

groups.name: Display & titles
groups.note: Platform system faces: SF Pro on Apple, Roboto on Android, Segoe UI on Windows. Sizes are px on web, pt on iOS, sp on Android.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero numbers and marketing headlines. Web and tablet only; at most one per screen.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Screen titles (web page H1, iOS large title).

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles, sheet headers, mobile nav-bar titles.

groups.name: Body & UI
groups.note: 16px body keeps mobile inputs from zooming on iOS.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Everything you need to ship a tidy app, nothing you don’t.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your changes were saved to the shared workspace.
styles.usage: Default body copy and input values on web and mobile.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense web UI: table cells, secondary descriptions, list subtitles.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels, form labels, tabs, list-row titles in dense layouts.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text, timestamps, bottom-nav labels, badge text.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Group labels above lists and table sections. Set in uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code, IDs, keys and logs.

spacing.note: 4px base grid, shared by web (px) and mobile (pt/dp).

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges: badge dot offset, icon optical alignment.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside small controls; label-to-input gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; gap between chips; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (sm); list-row vertical padding; field-to-field in dense forms.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default padding: cards, list rows, mobile screen gutter, button horizontal padding (md).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Field-to-field gap in forms; button horizontal padding (lg).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on web; dialog padding; gap between card groups; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections on mobile; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between page sections on web.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top padding on desktop; hero spacing.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Large marketing sections only.

radius.note: Soft and modular: radii grow with the size of the thing.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, inline code, tiny tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small buttons (sm), tooltips, segmented-control thumbs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus, list-row highlights.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, alerts, toasts, segmented-control tracks.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom-sheet top corners, app icon (scaled).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, switches, pills, the active bottom-nav indicator.

shadow.note: Light: soft zinc-tinted shadows. Dark: shadows deepen and surfaces lighten, so elevation also comes from surface-elevated.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons (secondary), inputs at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest (optional: a border-subtle outline is enough on web).

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, dropdown menus, popovers, sticky headers.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, toasts: anything floating above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring (web): a 2px canvas-colour gap, then 2px of solid focus colour. Box-shadow, so it follows the radius.

size.note: Control and icon sizes. Mobile touch targets are never smaller than control-md (44).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inputs: dense web toolbars and tables only.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs and list-row touch targets on web and mobile.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Prominent mobile CTAs and full-width form buttons.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside small buttons, badges, field messages.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size in buttons, inputs, list rows.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom-nav, top app bar and standalone icon buttons.

tokens.name: nav-bar
tokens.usage: Mobile top app bar and web header height.

tokens.name: tab-bar
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom navigation height (plus the safe-area inset).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of web page content.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones: two-up chips and cards.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets: bottom nav becomes a side rail; dialogs stop being sheets.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop: persistent sidebar, multi-column layouts.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Wide desktop: content capped at content-max.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky headers and the bottom nav.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and snackbars: always on top.

opacity.note: Use sparingly; prefer the disabled colour tokens for text.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (whole control, not text alone).

tokens.name: opacity-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed feedback on mobile icons and images.
